blocks.text: The weather has surely been devastating. As we mentioned in our past letters the polar vortex has shown its strength continuing well into March. In September I mentioned the element of unexpected weather events coming, earthquakes and volcanic activity are increasing. As of this writing a powerful “bomb cyclone” slammed the Central United States with hurricane-like winds and blizzard conditions and was followed by mammoth flooding. Melting ice and snow in the flooding rivers and streams have caused much devastation to farmlands, eating everything away. A troublesome season is expected ahead. – In other countries: Tropical Cyclone Idai, a real humanitarian disaster of large proportions, worst in 20 years, may have killed over 1,000, devastated 3 countries, affecting 1.5 million people in its wake. Would be the deadliest tropical cyclone on record to have hit southern Africa. – The world is in utter chaos. Riots and rebellion is almost in every nation. Riots in France as well as Venezuela with vast social unrest. – Mass killings happening in unexpected places i.e. New Zealand, Netherlands, etc. – As if this wasn’t bad enough, the axis of the earth is changing rapidly. (Read Isa. 24:1) It is noted that time is shortening for the moon to rise and set as well as the earth. Read all of Isa. Chapter 24 to find the hour approaching and the hour we are living in. Now let us put this into perspective with the following quote from Brother Neal Frisby’s writings.

WORLD CHANGES – As we can see we are still in the cycle of change and more coming. Dramatic movements for the years. As one little paper said, “the whole world is on the move, changing global borders and boundaries present stress and crisis.” It sounded like what has been on the Scripts. Part of this we have seen and more coming. It means major changes for countries, governments, big business, banking, large corporations, industry, insurance, the medical field and hospitals; they are all under pressure. The foundations of all the above are easily shaken and even just a small jolt can cause the whole structure to crumble. Scandals continue to be exposed, etc.

CONTINUING – Major earth changes continue, freak weather conditions, man-made accidents related to chemicals, liquids, oil, computers and electronics; and on the positive side innovative discoveries and new inventions in these areas. (We quote) In general the old law, authority, structure, and dreams are shattered. This breakdown opens up the way for birth of new law and order, structure, dreams and ideas. As always sudden breakdown may lead to chaos before new beginnings actually take hold. And they said whether its breakthroughs or breakdowns, one thing is certain the world is at the crossroads of the 21st century. And a New World Order (for good or bad) is emerging. Our answer to that is, at first it will look good to the people, but in the final end it will be the worst thing to ever occur to this planet. When it reaches its near fullness Rev. 17 is fulfilling. And its final great change will be Rev. chap. 13. And in a few years it will all go up in fire and brimstone. (Rev. 18:8-10) The Scripts have spoken of all of this many years in advance, and now it is approaching with swiftness. We are headed for a flood of differential events. An ominous hour looms before this world. Scientists claim our clocks are slightly changing. We are headed for a worldwide axis jolt. So before this age ends, there will be momentous activity including nature and the population.

LATTER TIMES – Far greater than the California quakes are coming over the world! And then the awesome axis shatters the earth! Rev. 16:18, “And there were voices, and thunders, and lightning; and there was a great earthquake such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake!” Vr. 19, “and the cities of the nations fell.” Note: Many type plagues are going to strike this planet. Rejoice! A sign the elect will soon depart! – TIME IS FLEETING – There is one thing for certain we are definitely at a crossroad. The Christians are in the valley of decision and will have to take a bold stand or fall behind. All kinds of sorcery and deception will appear as an angel of light to deceive them. Jesus said, watch and pray that you escape all of these things and stand before Him. We are approaching the twilight hour of all of these events. One must be prepared. Those on sand will sink, and those on the rock (Word) will stand. They will hear the midnight cry and disappear. So this is our hour to witness and bring in the harvest of souls. You can practically see Jesus, the Lord of the harvest, waiting for the final workers! Be ye also ready! - End quote.

This month we are offering a book called “Prophecy Part 1 – Coming World Events” and DVD, “Faith Is the Answer.” I personally want to thank you for your support. Truly we are living in harvest time and the most vital time in history. Your help at this hour is more important than it has ever been to witness and save souls. The Lord will bless and keep you as we work together. I’ll be praying for you.
